components.name: Talk Bars
components.description: Unlabeled 88px click-to-talk control: five ice bars on void.
components.css: .ds-talk { width: 88px; height: 88px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #d8f4ff; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-talk:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8f4ff; outline-offset: 10px; } .ds-bars { position: relative; width: 88px; height: 88px; } .ds-bars i { position: absolute; width: 10px; border-radius: 5px; background: currentColor; transform-origin: center; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(1) { left: 6px; top: 34px; height: 20px; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(2) { left: 22px; top: 22px; height: 44px; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(3) { left: 38px; top: 10px; height: 68px; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(4) { left: 54px; top: 22px; height: 44px; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(5) { left: 70px; top: 34px; height: 20px; }

components.name: Talk Bars Recording
components.description: Hold state: bars pulse with staggered scaleY loops.
components.css: .ds-talk { width: 88px; height: 88px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #d8f4ff; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-talk:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8f4ff; outline-offset: 10px; } .ds-bars { position: relative; width: 88px; height: 88px; } .ds-bars i { position: absolute; width: 10px; border-radius: 5px; background: currentColor; transform-origin: center; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(1) { left: 6px; top: 34px; height: 20px; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(2) { left: 22px; top: 22px; height: 44px; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(3) { left: 38px; top: 10px; height: 68px; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(4) { left: 54px; top: 22px; height: 44px; } .ds-bars i:nth-child(5) { left: 70px; top: 34px; height: 20px; } .ds-talk-recording .ds-bars i:nth-child(1) { animation: ds-bar-side 520ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) infinite; } .ds-talk-recording .ds-bars i:nth-child(2) { animation: ds-bar-mid 380ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) infinite; } .ds-talk-recording .ds-bars i:nth-child(3) { animation: ds-bar-center 460ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) infinite; } .ds-talk-recording .ds-bars i:nth-child(4) { animation: ds-bar-mid 420ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) infinite reverse; } .ds-talk-recording .ds-bars i:nth-child(5) { animation: ds-bar-side 560ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) infinite reverse; } @keyframes ds-bar-side { 50% { transform: scaleY(1.45); } } @keyframes ds-bar-mid { 50% { transform: scaleY(0.62); } } @keyframes ds-bar-center { 50% { transform: scaleY(0.8); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-talk-recording .ds-bars i { animation: none; opacity: 0.55; } }

components.name: Mic Denial
components.description: pt-BR failure: title and recovery centered under the control.
components.html: Sem microfonePermita o microfone para falar com Rafael.
components.css: .ds-fail { margin: 0; text-align: center; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.4; color: #d8f4ff; } .ds-fail strong { display: block; font-weight: 560; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-fail span { display: block; font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview:
Rafael’s visual world is a near-black field and one ice-cyan mark. The home is the talk: five rounded bars sit alone in the center of the void. There is no wordmark, no inbox list, no holographic ring, and no labeled button. Presence is the bars; everything else is absence.

Density is extreme sparsity. The palette is two values. Motion lives only inside the bars while Rafael is listening. Failure is plain pt-BR type under the control — named, recoverable, then gone again. The aesthetic philosophy is refusal: if it is not the talk, it does not appear.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed void field (#05070c) with no texture, gradient, or second surface
One 88×88 ice control: five symmetric rounded bars (#d8f4ff)
A click starts the bars; another click returns them to rest
Mic denial is centered ice type below the control — no toast, modal, or chrome

rules.name: The Two-Value Rule
rules.body: Only void and ice. No third fill, tint wash, or brand accent on this world’s surfaces.

rules.name: The Ice-Is-Signal Rule
rules.body: Ice appears only as the control, its focus ring, selection, or failure copy. It is never decorative ornament.

rules.name: The Silent Idle Rule
rules.body: No visible type on the idle home. Copy appears only for mic denial.

rules.name: The Bars-Are-Brand Rule
rules.body: Do not invent a display face or wordmark for the home. The five bars carry identity.

rules.name: The Centered Hold Rule
rules.body: The 88px bars remain the sole visual anchor at every viewport; do not pin them to corners or grow them with breakpoints.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, or ring frames. Recording state is bar motion, not elevation.

rules.name: The Five-Bar Silhouette Rule
rules.body: The talk control is this exact five-bar geometry. Do not substitute a mic glyph, waveform ring, or labeled pill.

dos: Do keep the home as void + one unlabeled 88px ice bars control.
Do use ice for bars, focus, selection, and mic-failure copy only.
Do animate bars on click and stop on the next click; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do show pt-BR denial as title + recovery under the control when the mic is blocked.
donts: Don't put the inbox list, date, logo, or wordmark on the home.
Don't wrap the bars in a holographic ring, glow, or second frame.
Don't add a visible idle label, badge, or kicker on the control.
Don't introduce a third brand color or a card/panel surface on this field.
